graph.name: AWS Solutions: Simple and Secure Media Exchange on AWS
graph.notes: media transfer is costly and time-taking and need to be secure.Use S3 to transfer large media files with a pub/sub model: pub side has write permission to a shared bucket, sub side has read permission. Use events and notification; both sides can develop their own workflow. Access control using AWS Identity Management (no additional credential to manage).
